pages.title: Green checks are having a moment
blocks: works just as well with a plain white T-shirt as it does with a matching skirt. This season’s versions favour a relaxed shoulder and contrasting pocket trim.
Choose one strong pattern and keep the rest simple. For evening wear, add a silk scarf or a narrow belt.
Our editor favours dark green checks with brass buttons. Dry-clean only, unless you were hoping to buy a smaller jacket.
pages.snippet: The country-club classic returns, with softer tailoring and brighter accessories.

pages.title: Volunteers build stronger local partnerships
blocks: , West Region coordinator at Open Skies, led a workshop on recruiting and supporting community volunteers.
The session covered induction, safeguarding and the mysterious disappearance of every working marker pen.
Local groups can contact the foundation’s programme office for future training dates.
pages.snippet: Claire Sutton led a practical workshop for local volunteer groups.

pages.title: Small grants, practical results
blocks: presented the North Region’s small-grants programme at the community centre.
Projects included a repair café, a neighbourhood garden and new equipment for the youth club.
Applications will be reviewed by the regional panel. Biscuits will be reviewed by everyone.
pages.snippet: Nora Bell outlined community funding opportunities in the North Region.

pages.title: Clare Sutton | Ceramics and workshops
blocks: Clare Sutton makes hand-thrown stoneware from a small studio on Market Lane.
Weekend workshops cover bowls, glazing and accepting that your first mug may resemble an ashtray.
Studio visits by appointment. Wholesale enquiries welcome.
pages.snippet: Clare Sutton: handmade stoneware, studio visits and pottery classes.

pages.title: Norah Bell | Piano lessons
blocks: Norah Bell offers individual piano lessons for beginners and returning players.
Evening appointments are available at the Riverside teaching studio.
Patient tuition. The metronome is less patient.
pages.snippet: Norah Bell offers piano tuition and accompaniment services.
